board_configuration: Catherine's board with the UART TX/RX jumper workaround; no serial output in timed intervals
scope: Initial per-core FIR characterization; one core filters at a time; not parallel speedup measurements

provenance.source: Successful terminal output pasted by Catherine in the project chat on 2026-11-23
provenance.note: Original collection intentionally printed results without retaining measurement files. These summaries are transcribed from that output; individual trial arrays are not reconstructed.

kernel_call_profile.measurement: For each trial, sum of eight individually timed FIR-call intervals; statistics are over those 31 sums
included: Kernel selection and argument evaluation within each timing bracket
Timer-read and barrier instrumentation; no overhead subtraction
kernel_call_profile.other_core_activity: No concurrent FIR work; M4 prepares and waits for completion during M0+ profiles
kernel_call_profile.validation: Collector reported PASS after full-output, guard, ownership and completion checks

m4_repeat.measurement: Original uninstrumented M4-only direct-call whole-batch elapsed time; distinct from summed per-call profiles above
m4_repeat.reference: greedy-results.json, 100 MHz run, matching kernel and workload
m4_repeat.note: All 25 reported medians matched. This establishes repeatability for this benchmark and does not establish identical hardware behavior for every workload.
